• To disable the GPS tracker on a Bird scooter, follow these steps:

1.  Open the Bird app on your smartphone.
2.  Tap on the "Account" or "Profile" icon (usually represented by a person's silhouette) in the top right corner of the screen.
3.  Scroll down to the "Settings" or "Account Settings" section.
4.  Look for the "Scooter Settings" or "Ride Settings" option and tap on it.
5.  Scroll down to the "Location Services" or "GPS Settings" section.
6.  Toggle the switch next to "Location Services" or "GPS" to the "Off" position.
7.  Confirm that you want to disable location services by tapping on the "Turn Off" or "Disable" button.
8.  Alternatively, you can also disable the GPS tracker by going to your phone's settings app, then navigating to "Location" or "Location Services" and toggling the switch to the "Off" position.
9.  Make sure to also check the Bird app's permissions in your phone's settings app to ensure that it is not requesting location access.
10. If you are still unable to disable the GPS tracker, try restarting your phone or reinstalling the Bird app.

Note: Disabling the GPS tracker may affect the functionality of the Bird app and your ability to rent or use the scooter.
